title: Trinity Ritual Check Template
description: Declarative verification spec for a ritual. Authority: TRINITY_RITUAL_CONSTITUTION_V1_1_RC.md Article VI. One file per ritual at .ai/rituals/<ritual>/check.template.json.

required_artifacts.description: Artifact paths (or path-templates) that MUST exist for the check to pass.

required_headings.description: Markdown headings required inside the ritual's write artifact.

required_fields.description: Map of {artifact_path: required_field_or_jsonpath}. Field MUST be present in the artifact.

required_evidence_refs.description: Map of {evidence_key: spec} declaring which evidence references must accompany the ritual output.

predicate.description: Predicate expression in dotted-path form, e.g. 'memory_handling.mode == index'.

required.description: If true, predicate failure -> BLOCK; if false -> WARN per failure_behavior.on_optional_failure.

required_structural_predicates.description: Article VI — SHOULD be preferred over brittle phrase matching.

required_phrases.description: Literal phrases that MUST appear (use sparingly; prefer structural predicates).

forbidden_phrases.description: Literal phrases that MUST NOT appear in the artifact body.

forbidden_actions.description: Actions that MUST NOT be executed during ritual body.

allowed_roles.description: Roles permitted to write the ritual's artifact (Article XVIII).

forbidden_roles.description: Roles explicitly forbidden to write the artifact (Article XVIII).
